contributionMap.claim: For every pair (m,n) the reduced denominator of C_{m,n} is exactly [F_gcd(m,n)]_q and the reduced numerator is the Hilbert series of an Artinian weighted complete intersection; so C_{m,n} has nonnegative coefficients whenever gcd(m,n) <= 2 (the nonnegativity observed by Bergeron-Ceballos-Kuestner for m, n <= 15)

limitationTriage.limitation: No combinatorial interpretation on the original path-domino tilings (BCK Open Problems 4.3 and 5.4 in the intended sense)
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Is there an explicit regular sequence with explicit Groebner basis for all pairs?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: attempted in the revision round: pure-power models fail for most pairs (for example (10,4)); no uniform family found

limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Can each fixed width be reduced to a finite computation with an effective m_0(n)?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: widths five to seven certified exactly; effectivity stated as a remark, not proved

limitationTriage.limitation: Galois-twisted non-crystallographic and reducible Coxeter quotients
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Which twisted or reducible products are polynomial and positive?
